title: Mysql fails to rollback after invalid undo record

comments.text:
Description:
I've some databases on RDS Aurora. Everything worked fine until I updated the cluster from mysql 8.0.28 to 8.0.32.
After RDS restarted the cluster, everything was broken. Mysql continue to restart the service without any possibility to recover

How to repeat:
I don't know the real cause of the bug; the RDS Aurora updates are completely managed

Hi Mr .Renda,

Thank you for your bug report.

However, you have made an error. You have set a category to "Server", while you either have a problem with Group Replication or with Cluster.

So, please fix that first.

Next, this is a forum for the bug reports with a fully repeatable test cases, involving all SQL statements, all configurations and so on.

Can't repeat.

Hi,

Please report a bug to Amazon, this does not look like our build of MySQL. Amazon RDS uses their own patches that change behavior of MySQL Server.
